mapper.sql:
( SELECT res.ID_ AS id, res.NAME_ AS name, def.NAME_ AS category, def.KEY_ AS "processDefinitionKey", u.nickname AS "startUserNickname", CAST(u.dept_id AS VARCHAR) AS "startDeptName", res.START_TIME_ AS "createTime", res.END_TIME_ AS "endTime", (CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(var.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), var.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} LIMIT 1) = '1' THEN 1 WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(var.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), var.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} LIMIT 1) = '2' THEN 2 WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(var.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), var.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} LIMIT 1) = '3' THEN 3 WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(var.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), var.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} LIMIT 1) = '4' THEN 4 WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(var.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), var.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} LIMIT 1) = '5' THEN 5 WHEN res.END_TIME_ IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN res.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL AND res.DELETE_REASON_ IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN res.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL AND (res.DELETE_REASON_ = 'MI_END' OR LOWER(res.DELETE_REASON_) = 'completed') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS status, (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(var.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), var.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_RESULT} LIMIT 1) AS "processResult", (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(var.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), var.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} LIMIT 1) AS "processStatus", (SELECT var.TEXT_ FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_REASON} LIMIT 1) AS "processReason", (SELECT string_agg(t.NAME_, ', ') FROM ACT_RU_TASK t WHERE t.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_) AS "currTaskName", (SELECT string_agg(tu.nickname, ', ') FROM ACT_RU_TASK t LEFT JOIN system_users tu ON t.ASSIGNEE_ = CAST(tu.id AS VARCHAR) WHERE t.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_) AS "currTaskAssignee", (SELECT var.TEXT_ FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_SOURCE_UNIT} LIMIT 1) AS "sourceUnit", ( SELECT CASE WHEN count(f.id) = 0 THEN '网页新建' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) IS NULL THEN '未知来源' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) = '市局公告' THEN '通知公告' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) = '林业局公文' THEN '林业局收文' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) = '省厅公文' THEN '省厅收文' ELSE max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) END FROM bpm_receive_doc receive_doc LEFT JOIN t_file_exchange f ON f.doc_id = receive_doc.id AND COALESCE(f.deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE receive_doc.process_instance_id = res.ID_ AND COALESCE(receive_doc.deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY receive_doc.id LIMIT 1 ) AS source, '现有数据' AS "dataType", (SELECT var.TEXT_ FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_URGENCY} LIMIT 1) AS "urgencyDegree", (SELECT CASE WHEN var.LONG_ IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(to_timestamp(var.LONG_ / 1000), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE var.TEXT_ END FROM ACT_HI_VARINST var WHERE var.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND var.NAME_ = #{VAR_DEADLINE} LIMIT 1) AS "deadlineDate", FALSE AS "isHistory", NULL AS "projectId", 'flowable' AS "sourceType", res.ID_ AS "sortId" FROM ACT_HI_PROCINST res LEFT JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON res.PROC_DEF_ID_ = def.ID_ LEFT JOIN system_users u ON res.START_USER_ID_ = CAST(u.id AS VARCHAR) WHERE ( #{superAdmin} = TRUE
OR def.KEY_ IN
#{managedKey}
OR res.START_USER_ID_ = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST t WHERE t.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND t.ASSIGNEE_ = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST deletedStatus WHERE deletedStatus.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND deletedStatus.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} AND COALESCE(CAST(deletedStatus.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), deletedStatus.TEXT_) = '5' )
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(p.proinst_id AS VARCHAR) AS id, p.proinst_name AS name, CASE WHEN rd.id IS NOT NULL THEN '收文' WHEN lv.id IS NOT NULL THEN '请假管理' WHEN te.id IS NOT NULL THEN '因公外出' WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN '会议报告单' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzfy' THEN '行政复议' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzss' THEN '行政诉讼' ELSE '历史流程' END AS category, CASE WHEN rd.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'receive_doc' WHEN lv.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'leave' WHEN te.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'time_explain' WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'confflow' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzfy' THEN 'xzfy' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzss' THEN 'xzss' ELSE 'history' END AS "processDefinitionKey", p.creator AS "startUserNickname", COALESCE(rd.send_dept, p.responsible_dept) AS "startDeptName", p.start_date AS "createTime", p.end_date AS "endTime", CASE WHEN p.proinst_status IN (2, 8) OR p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 2 WHEN p.end_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 3 END AS status, CAST(CASE WHEN p.proinst_status IN (2, 8) OR p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS VARCHAR) AS "processResult", CAST(CASE WHEN p.proinst_status IN (2, 8) OR p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS VARCHAR) AS "processStatus", NULL AS "processReason", CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NULL THEN p.inact ELSE NULL END AS "currTaskName", CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NULL THEN p.intransactor ELSE NULL END AS "currTaskAssignee", COALESCE(rd.send_dept, p.responsible_dept) AS "sourceUnit", rd.source AS source, CASE WHEN p.batch_no = 'HIS_WF_UNFINISHED_BEFORE_2026' THEN '历史未办结' ELSE '历史已办结' END AS "dataType", CAST(p.emergency AS VARCHAR) AS "urgencyDegree", to_char(p.deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "deadlineDate", TRUE AS "isHistory", p.project_id AS "projectId", 'history' AS "sourceType", CAST(p.proinst_id AS VARCHAR) AS "sortId" FROM hist_wf.proinst p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.project_id, MAX(r.id) AS id, MAX(r.send_dept) AS send_dept, CASE WHEN count(f.id) = 0 THEN '网页新建' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) IS NULL THEN '未知来源' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) = '市局公告' THEN '通知公告' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) = '林业局公文' THEN '林业局收文' WHEN max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) = '省厅公文' THEN '省厅收文' ELSE max(NULLIF(f.operation_information, '')) END AS source FROM bpm_receive_doc r LEFT JOIN t_file_exchange f ON f.doc_id = r.id AND COALESCE(f.deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE COALESCE(r.deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY r.project_id ) rd ON rd.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM bpm_leave WHERE COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) lv ON lv.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM t_time_explain WHERE COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) te ON te.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM t_confflow WHERE COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) cf ON cf.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MIN(business_type) AS business_type FROM hist_wf.biz_project_map WHERE business_type IN ('xzfy', 'xzss') GROUP BY project_id ) bpm ON bpm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE ( #{superAdmin} = TRUE
OR CASE WHEN rd.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'receive_doc' WHEN lv.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'leave' WHEN te.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'time_explain' WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'confflow' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzfy' THEN 'xzfy' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzss' THEN 'xzss' ELSE 'history' END IN
#{managedKey}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hist_wf.actinst a WHERE a.source_schema = p.source_schema AND a.proinst_id = p.proinst_id AND a.user_id = #{userId} ) ) ) unified

where.if: AND (unified.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.processInstanceId}, '%') OR unified."projectId" LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.processInstanceId}, '%'))

AND ( unified."processDefinitionKey" = #{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'receive_doc' AND unified."processDefinitionKey" IN ('receive_doc', 'receice_doc_v2_copy_copy')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'leave' AND unified."processDefinitionKey" IN ('leave', 'oa_leave')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'time_explain' AND unified."processDefinitionKey" IN ('time_explain', 'oa_out')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'confflow' AND unified."processDefinitionKey" IN ('confflow', 'conference_report')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'xzfy' AND unified."processDefinitionKey" IN ('xzfy', 'oa_review')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'xzss' AND unified."processDefinitionKey" IN ('xzss', 'oa_lawsuit')) )
AND unified."deadlineDate" IS NOT NULL AND (CURRENT_DATE - TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(unified."deadlineDate", 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= #{reqVO.overdueDays}

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM
ORDER BY
unified.name ASC unified.name DESC unified.category ASC unified.category DESC unified."sourceUnit" ASC unified."sourceUnit" DESC unified.source ASC unified.source DESC unified."dataType" ASC unified."dataType" DESC unified."urgencyDegree" ASC unified."urgencyDegree" DESC unified."createTime" ASC unified."createTime" DESC unified."deadlineDate" ASC unified."deadlineDate" DESC unified.status ASC unified.status DESC unified."currTaskName" ASC unified."currTaskName" DESC unified."currTaskAssignee" ASC unified."currTaskAssignee" DESC unified."createTime" DESC
, unified."sortId" DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.pageSize} OFFSET (#{reqVO.pageNo} - 1) * #{reqVO.pageSize}
